I do not put chemical fertilizer on my maize because the rains in Dodoma are not reliable and last season my cousin lost the money he spent on it when the drought came. I will spread two cartloads of cow manure from my animals on this plot before planting, the way my father always did. I will use the seed I kept from my own last harvest — it survives the dry spells better, and I do not have cash to buy from the agro-dealer. My wife and I will work this plot ourselves with the hand hoe, weeding twice when the weeds come up.
